propositions: Container plan-review attestations over-invalidate because containers rarely declare their own file_impact, causing empty dependency sets that fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation where any unrelated commit forces re-review.

A container's actual code-drift scope should be the union of its own file_impact, review citations, and direct children's declared file_impact (poison rule: if any non-closed child has empty file_impact, inheritance is blocked and fallback applies).

Inheritance must be direct-children-only because the material-fingerprint lattice self-heals one level deep via pin/material drift; grandchild changes are covered by deeper tickets' own attestations, mirroring the review model.

The children list is already fetched by the orchestrator (ctx.children) and passed through sign_plan_review → dependency_hashes without new store reads; children=None (resign/drift-refresh path) conservatively skips inheritance.
P9 DET-floor container rule changes from unconditional pass to advisory-only (never blocking) when inheritance is poisoned, naming the offending children; leaf behavior unchanged.

Acceptance verified: inherited union signed and manifest-inspected, poison rule keeps pre-change set with whole-HEAD fallback, closed children excluded, claim outcomes correct (unrelated commits pass, child-file drift blocks), child file_impact edits invalidate container attestation, P9 advisory functional, docs updated.
